name: student-saas
description: Multi-tenant student management SaaS (MERN + Prisma + Neon)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npx --prefix backend prisma generate && npx --prefix backend prisma db push --accept-data-loss
